content: RLS testing: enable pgTAP extension, write SQL test files under supabase/tests using pgTAP assertions (results_eq, throws_ok) run via supabase test db, simulating different auth.uid()/roles per test to assert cross-tenant denial and same-tenant access. For app-level testing, Vitest is the current standard for Next.js 15 unit tests (Server Actions, Zod schemas, sync components) since it uses Vite's transform pipeline and needs no babel/ts-jest config; async Server Components still need Playwright E2E. Playwright supports test.use({ geolocation, permissions }) and browser context permission grants for camera/geolocation, applied before navigation.
